title: Kenyan Folk Songs
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use songs from learners' own communities, with respect. Examples are for a teacher to confirm.

skills.key_step: The child classifies Kenyan folk songs (lullabies, work, wedding, initiation, war, funeral dirges, praise, play songs) by occasion, mood and words.

floor.question: When is a work song sung?

contexts: a music festival class set piece

board.do: A slow, sad song at a burial.

misconceptions.repair: Hum a lullaby softly; ask who it is for.

misconceptions.ask: When is a work song sung?
misconceptions.repair: Sing a work song while miming digging in time.

misconceptions.ask: Which song is sung at a funeral?
misconceptions.repair: Compare the mood and tempo: slow and sad (dirge), lively (wedding).

misconceptions.ask: A song praises a brave hunter. What type is it?
misconceptions.repair: Read the words: who is praised?

checks.question: A song sung while pounding grain is which type?
